general_tips: The site's indoor-plant care article gives general advice; individual plant requirements can differ.
Choose suitable light; the article describes bright indirect light for many indoor plants.
Check soil before watering and avoid overwatering rather than following a fixed schedule.
Use pots with drainage holes and soil suited to the plant type.
Keep plants away from cold drafts and sudden temperature changes.
Rotate plants for even growth and gently remove dust from leaves.
plant_care.specific_care_note: Only Echinocactus has a meaningful product-specific description. Do not apply generic blog advice to every species, infer a watering frequency from moisture scores or invent pet-safety claims.
